ambient_events: A garment on the far rail turns slowly on its motorised hook, catching the light like poured mercury.
The floor-length mirror warms as you pass, throwing a flattering key-light that follows you a beat too long.
Somewhere a steamer exhales a soft ghost of lavender and hot silk.
A price tag flips over on its thread. You decide not to look.
The house sound, one sustained synth chord, impossibly patient, swells and settles.
description: Aurelia is less a shop than a lit vitrine you are permitted to stand inside. The walls are brushed graphite; the racks are single slender rails, each holding one garment, spaced like paintings. A mag-lev display plinth turns a liquid-chrome gown under a pin-spot in the centre of the room. Everything is underlit in cool violet except the full-height mirror by the fitting alcove, which throws a warm, forgiving light that makes you look like the most expensive version of yourself. There are no prices anywhere. That is the price.

window.description: A full-height pane onto the street, kept just clean enough to trade through. Whatever the weather is doing out there, it is doing it in plain view.
window.name: the shopfront window
